source: scripts/qx-contrast.cjs — WCAG AA with alpha compositing up the ancestor chain, run against the published port

findings.element: Contained buttons (+ NEW EVALUATION, Run, primary actions)
findings.finding: White on #2196F3 measures 3.12:1 — below the 4.5:1 AA minimum for normal text.
findings.user_impact: The primary action on every screen is the least legible text on it.
findings.suggested_fix: Contained buttons take primary.dark #1769AA (5.77:1); accents, links, selected rows and focus underlines stay #2196F3. One token.
findings.note: This is the open contrast decision, unchanged since 2026-09-14. It is a finding about ETC's product palette, not only this prototype.

findings.element: Group count next to each accordion header ("6 Evaluations")
findings.user_impact: The row count for each evaluation type is hard to read, and it is the only thing telling you how big a collapsed section is.
findings.suggested_fix: Use text.secondary (#666, 5.7:1) for the count. It is information, not a disabled control.
findings.note: Carried over from the vanilla, which uses the same token here.

findings.user_impact: Status is the column people scan; the in-progress state is the hardest to read of the three.
findings.suggested_fix: Darken the warning token for text use, or use a filled chip with a dark label.
